dialogues.speaker: Maillardet
dialogues.text: #{M#Sir, ma'am}{F#Good ladies}, are you ready to take part in the Icewind Suite?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Try "Dirge of Coppelia."

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Try "Nemesis of Coppelius."

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Let's do this later.

dialogues.speaker: Maillardet
dialogues.text: The dance floor is always open for you.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Tell me about the Icewind Suite...

dialogues.speaker: Maillardet
dialogues.text: What would you like to know?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: What's the story of the Icewind Suite?

dialogues.speaker: Maillardet
dialogues.text: A fine question!

dialogues.speaker: Maillardet
dialogues.text: Like how Coppelius was defeated in a war against temptation, and was thus punished. Or how Coppelia so loved him that she nearly died from grief as a result.

dialogues.speaker: Maillardet
dialogues.text: Or how, to save the imprisoned Coppelius, Coppelia would set out on a journey.

dialogues.speaker: Maillardet
dialogues.text: Or how, no matter how things go, the drama shall end in a lovers' dance.

dialogues.speaker: Maillardet
dialogues.text: Haha! Well, actually, that was just me making some story bits up. I mean, I'm no literary scholar, just a researcher who works with clockwork meka.

dialogues.speaker: Maillardet
dialogues.text: As far as I'm concerned, their function is more important than their story.

dialogues.speaker: Maillardet
dialogues.text: However, if you're that interested in the story... Well, I'll consider.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Why do they need combat skills?

dialogues.speaker: Maillardet
dialogues.text: Um... Well, actually, Mr. Bossuet was against that at first, too.

dialogues.speaker: Maillardet
dialogues.text: I guess you could consider this... my personal interest?

dialogues.speaker: Maillardet
dialogues.text: See? Now that Coppelius and Coppelia have combat abilities, their dance now exudes elegance as well as power!

dialogues.speaker: Maillardet
dialogues.text: Regardless of what anyone else thinks, I believe that this was a successful attempt.

dialogues.speaker: Maillardet
dialogues.text: Of course, there was a happy accident involved... With Mr. Bossuet's departure from the Institute, there's no one left to reject my research plans!
